title: Director, Asset-Backed Trading
description:
Habitat Energy is a fast growing technology company focussed on the physical and financial optimization of energy storage and renewable generation assets globally through complex models and trading. By maximizing the returns from these assets we aim to drive investment in renewable energy and accelerate the transition to a low carbon world. Our rapidly growing team of 130+ people in Austin, TX, Oxford, UK, and Melbourne, Australia brings together exceptionally talented and passionate people in the domains of energy trading, data science, software engineering and renewable energy management.

We are seeking an experienced, commercially-minded Director of Asset-Backed Trading to lead the day-to-day and strategic management of Habitat's contracted battery storage (BESS) and renewable energy (RES) portfolios, with primary responsibility across ERCOT and PJM. This role sits at the head of two integrated functions - the Asset-Backed Trading team (Day Ahead positioning and portfolio management) and the RT Dispatch team (real-time execution and operations) - and is accountable for the commercial performance, risk discipline, and client experience delivered across both. Trading and dispatch decisions are made at Habitat's discretion within an agreed risk mandate for each client - this is active portfolio management and risk-taking on client-owned assets, not instructed, trade-by-trade execution.

The Director will own the end-to-end asset management and trading operating model: ensuring positions are prepared and defended with rigor, that Day Ahead and Real Time workflows are tightly coordinated, that performance is tracked and benchmarked systematically, and that client relationships are managed proactively through both steady-state operations and high-risk events. This individual will also play a lead role in market expansion efforts — evaluating new protocols, tariffs, resource types, and markets — and in partnering with Analytics, Software, and Product teams to continuously improve trading models, control mechanisms, and platform capabilities. The Director will maintain responsibility for ensuring asset operations remain in line with QSE and MP regulations and requirements across relevant markets.

This role is well suited to someone who has grown their capabilities on asset management desk, has led people through high-stakes, time-sensitive operations, and is comfortable owning commercial outcomes across a diverse and growing asset base - batteries, renewables, and increasingly data centers - through rapidly changing market conditions across the US.

Requirements
Required skills and experience:

- Market Expertise: Deep working knowledge of US wholesale market structures; ability to apply market rules to battery, renewable, and load-based assets

- Team Leadership: Proven ability to lead and develop a team of asset managers operating in a 24/7, high-stakes environment

- Commercial Ownership: Ability to define and enforce performance benchmarks by resource type and contract, and to drive remediation when performance trends below target

- Risk Discipline: Experience establishing and enforcing trading limits, and leading written protocols for tail-event risk management, with clear sign-off and training processes

- Client Management: Set standards for asset-backed trading desk in conducting of quarterly reviews, coordination of RFI responses, onboarding, and drafting of communications protocols - ensuring clients have clear visibility into trading and performance decisions made under mandate

- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Ability to partner effectively with Quant, Applied Analytics, and Product teams on model development and platform features

- Process Rigor: Comfort owning and maintaining up-to-date process documentation, and running regular (at least bi-annual) team process reviews

- Communication: Clear, confident communicator able to defend positions with data, work across technical and non-technical audiences, and represent the desk to senior leadership and clients

‘Nice to have’ skills and experience:

- Direct experience managing load or controllable loads in ERCOT and/or PJM

- Familiarity with battery storage optimization/dispatch strategies and renewable forecasting fundamentals

- Experience evaluating new market protocols, tariffs, or resource types and leading operational build-out for market expansion

- Working knowledge of Excel, SQL, Python, or similar tools sufficient to engage credibly with quant/engineering partners on model logic and data needs

- Experience with NERC/Market Operator training and certification requirements

- Prior experience scaling a desk or team through a market-entry or growth phase (e.g., new ISO, new resource type, new client segment)

Personal Attributes:

- Ownership mentality: Treats commercial and operational outcomes as personally accountable, not just process-following

- Composure under pressure: Stays sharp and decisive during high-value, time-sensitive events

- Builder mindset: Comfortable creating structure and process where none exists, particularly as the desk expands into new resource types and markets

- Collaborative but direct: Works well across Trading, Asset Operations, Analytics, and Product, while being willing to challenge assumptions and hold a clear point of view"

Ultimately we are looking for someone who is a great fit for our company so we encourage you to apply even if you may not meet every requirement in this posting. We value diversity and our environment is supportive, challenging and focused on the consistent delivery of high quality, meaningful work.

In return, we’ll give you a competitive salary and considerable personal development opportunities. This role oversees teams that work shift patterns that include some weekend and non-business-hour work.

When you apply for a job with us, we process some of your personal information. You can find out more about how we process your information on our company website: https://habitat.energy/privacy-policy/ .

title: Origination Manager
description:
Habitat Energy is a fast growing technology company focussed on the physical and financial optimisation of energy storage and renewable generation assets globally through complex models and trading. By maximising the returns from these assets we aim to drive investment in renewable energy and accelerate the transition to a low carbon world. Our rapidly growing team of 130+ people in Austin, TX, Oxford, UK, and Melbourne, Australia brings together exceptionally talented and passionate people in the domains of energy trading, data science, software engineering and renewable energy management.

We have a vacancy for an Origination Manager to join our US team based in Austin, Texas, reporting to our Director of Origination. This is a senior individual contributor role with responsibility for business development and origination across our core optimization services as well as adjacent products in risk management and structured products. You will play a key role in shaping Habitat's commercial strategy in the US, from refining our pitch and value proposition, to supporting the development of new offerings, to laying the commercial groundwork for expansion into new markets. ERCOT will be your primary focus, with named expansion priorities including PJM, MISO, CAISO and NYISO. Habitat prides itself in offering best in class optimization capability to owners of battery storage and renewables, so you'll need an in-depth knowledge of ERCOT power markets and related technical topics, as well as great interpersonal and communication skills.

You will be responsible for:

- Owning origination activity across the full client acquisition lifecycle, including sourcing leads, delivering pitches, running demonstrations, responding to RFPs, developing proposals, modeling scenarios, negotiating commercial terms, and managing deals to close

- Generating awareness and building the Habitat Energy brand through networking, developing sales and marketing materials, and cultivating outbound and inbound opportunities

- Understanding prospective clients' needs and developing solutions that add value and match their problems and requirements

- Contributing to the refinement of Habitat's commercial strategy, pitch and positioning across both storage and renewables optimization use cases

- Supporting the buildout of Habitat's DART optimization offering and renewables optimization capabilities, both core to growth in ERCOT and to expansion into other US markets

- Supporting the development and commercialization of new products and offerings in partnership with our trading, product, and analytics teams

- Originating and structuring risk management and structured products, engaging with balance sheet providers, tolling offtakers, and developers to advance hedging partnerships and structured deal opportunities

- Supporting Habitat's expansion into new US markets, including developing the commercial case, building relationships, and laying the BD groundwork for entry into markets such as PJM, MISO, CAISO and SPP

- Managing and supporting client relationships from onboarding through go-live and beyond, including developing retention strategies

- Supporting advisory services by qualifying opportunities, developing proposals, and managing delivery and follow-up

Requirements
'Must have' skills and experience:

- 5+ years of energy market experience across business development, origination, energy trading, commodity markets, transaction support, consulting, asset management, or energy market modeling

- In-depth knowledge of ERCOT power markets; familiarity with other US ISOs (PJM, MISO, CAISO, NYISO) a strong plus

- Comfortable getting into detail on highly technical quantitative topics

- Excellent people skills, including the ability to establish and maintain strong relationships with clients and internal team

- Appreciation of the finer points of verbal and written communications, strong attention to detail

- Self motivated with the ability to take initiative, juggle multiple client priorities and solve difficult problems with a positive 'can do' attitude

- Comfort working in a non-hierarchical team environment working towards a shared goal

- A degree in business, economics, finance, computer science, engineering or related technical field

'Nice to have' skills and experience:

- Network of relationships within the US power markets, preferably IPPs, developers and/or energy-focused investment banking/private equity

- Experience in energy storage and/or renewables optimisation

- Experience originating and structuring risk management and structured products such as tolls, revenue floors, and hedging partnerships

- Experience supporting new market entry or commercial strategy development for expansion into new ISOs

- Experience developing and/or running analytical/technical pricing models

- Experience performing economic or project financial evaluations

- Graduate degree in business/STEM fields

Ultimately we are looking for someone who is a great fit for our company so we encourage you to apply even if you may not meet every requirement in this posting. We value diversity and our environment is supportive, challenging and focused on the consistent delivery of high quality, meaningful work.

In return, we'll give you a competitive salary, flexible working arrangements and a lot of personal development opportunities. We operate a hybrid working model with at least 2 days in our offices in Austin.

When you apply for a job with us, we process some of your personal information. You can find out more about how we process your information on our company website: https://habitat.energy/privacy-policy/

title: Scheduling & Operations Analyst
description:
Habitat Energy is a fast growing technology company focussed on the trading and algorithmic optimisation of energy storage and renewable assets around the world. Our mission is to deliver outstanding returns to our clients to increase the attractiveness of renewable energy globally and support the transition to a clean energy future. Our rapidly growing team of 130+ people in Austin, TX, Oxford, UK, and Melbourne, Australia brings together exceptionally talented and passionate people in the domains of energy trading, data science, software engineering and renewable energy management.

We have a vacancy for a Scheduling & Operations Analyst to join our team based in Oxford. This role will assist our 24/7 trading team with the day to day optimisation of our portfolio of battery storage assets across wholesale, balancing and ancillary markets. The Scheduling and Operations Analyst will provide in and out of hours cover to assist with monitoring of our live assets, and ensuring any issues are communicated and raised with relevant parties. This role also includes an element of trade support and confirmation checking with relevant trade counterparties.

Your responsibilities will include:
Live Operations:

- Monitoring of live energy storage and renewable assets both during normal office hours and out of hours as part of a shift rota.

- Respond to any asset issues that occur in a timely manner as per issue escalation policies.

Trading and Optimisation Support:

- Ensuring planned asset dispatch is delivered as per the traders instructions.

- Assist traders and the technology team with asset outage planning and testing

- Ensuring correct and accurate nomination of traded positions with our trading counterparts.

Asset Planning and Reporting:

- Ensure asset warranty conditions are tracked and managed effectively.

- Ensuring clients and customers are kept informed on asset conditions, and auditing delivery against our requirements.

Performance Monitoring, Reporting and Analysis:

- Responsible for performing analysis on operational and commercial data

- Updating internal databases with trading related information.

- Generation of incident reports and engagement with internal technology teams to ensure issues are reported and tracked.

Requirements
‘Must have’ skills and experience:

- Ability to multitask and retain excellent attention to detail

- Good written and verbal communication skills

- Must be able to operate independently and be happy to work in an office environment on a shift rotation

- Decisive and able to use own initiative in dealing with operational problems

- Familiarity with MS Excel

‘Nice to have’ skills and experience:

- Self Motivated

- Analysis background

- Critical Thinking

Ultimately we are looking for someone who is a great fit for our company so we encourage you to apply even if you may not meet every requirement in this posting. We value diversity and our environment is supportive, challenging and focused on the consistent delivery of high quality, meaningful work.

In return, we’ll give you a competitive salary, flexible working arrangements and a lot of personal development opportunities. This role works to shift patterns that will include some weekends shifts.

title: Senior Project Manager: Asset Onboarding
description:
Senior Project Manager: Asset Onboarding

Habitat Energy is a fast growing technology company focussed on the physical and financial optimisation of energy storage and renewable generation assets globally through complex models and trading. By maximising the returns from these assets we aim to drive investment in renewable energy and accelerate the transition to a low carbon world. Our rapidly growing team of 130+ people in Austin, TX, Oxford, UK, and Melbourne, Australia brings together exceptionally talented and passionate people in the domains of energy trading, data science, software engineering and renewable energy management.

We are seeking a Senior Project Manager for our Operations team in Oxford to manage contracted battery storage projects from execution through to initial trading revenue, maintaining full lifecycle ownership. As the central interface, you will coordinate clients, contractors, and internal teams to resolve divergent interests, tracking milestones and managing risks to ensure assets are fully registered, configured, and commissioned for immediate market participation. You will independently manage a sophisticated GB asset portfolio while driving continuous improvement of onboarding procedures, plans, and templates to enhance future integration efficiency. This role also includes Client Account Management to identify growth opportunities with current clients.

Your responsibilities will include:
Comprehensive End-to-End Management of Asset Onboarding and Offboarding Processes:

- Serve as the primary external representative and point of contact upon contract execution.

- Ensure onboarding procedures adhere to the highest standards.

- Coordinate internal and external stakeholders to achieve alignment with Habitat and industry timelines.

- Ensure assets are integrated or decommissioned without attributable delays.

- Lead effective risk and issue management, structured planning, and transparent communication across all departments.

Responsible for the implementation, maintenance and proactive continuous improvement of all Asset Onboarding Processes and associated Procedures:

- Develop procedures and plans to support the onboarding and offboarding of all UK-contracted clients.

- Deliver onboarding processes that meet best-in-class standards.

- Update documentation to align with the latest requirements and industry best practices.

- Collaborate with Software, Trading, and Operations teams to update procedures for new services or markets.

Advance our Asset Monitoring and Control Capabilities:

- Drive continuous improvement of the “control system” to enhance asset monitoring capabilities.

- Collaborate with the Software team to acquire insights from systems integrators.

- Apply key findings to new sites and internal initiatives.

- Support the Operations team in diagnosing and implementing control system refinements.

- Respond to operational challenges or enable entry into new markets and services.

Report and present Onboarding Objectives:

- Track specified onboarding metrics and report on progress in each area.

- Identify opportunities for improvement and develop change plans for senior management.

- Provide reporting at all levels, including Board Level (reporting to the Director of Trading and Operations).

- Share insights on Asset Owner/EPC/BESS trends to inform the commercial team’s future contract negotiations.

Requirements
Preferred skills and experience:

- 5+ years of proven experience in project or programme management.

- Demonstrable experience of GB market registration — metering, BSC and Elexon processes, BM Unit registration, and pre-qualification for NESO ancillary services.

- Background with construction contracts (familiarity with JCT, NEC, or FIDIC standard forms is advantageous).

- The authority and confidence to chair meetings with clients, contractors, network operators and industry bodies, take control of a plan and direct it back to Habitat's requirements.

- Ability to articulate complex technical concepts—such as EPC schedules, Elexon metering, connection agreements, and Grid Code compliance—clearly and accessibly across diverse audiences.

- Proactive risk management and structured planning, with a strong history of identifying delivery bottlenecks early and escalating them appropriately.

- A genuine self-starter. This role runs its own portfolio with minimal supervision.

‘Nice to have’ skills and experience:

- Project or Programme management of at least two GB grid-connected generation or storage assets taken from contract execution through to energisation and commercial operation.

- Experience with transmission-connected assets and NESO Bilateral Connection or Construction Agreements.

- Working knowledge of Capacity Market obligations and the EMR delivery framework.

- Exposure to SCADA or EMS deployment on generation assets, and to the protocols above.

- Familiarity with optimisation, tolling or route to market agreements from either side of the table.

- Formal project management qualification (APM, PRINCE2, PMP).

Ultimately we are looking for someone who is a great fit for our company so we encourage you to apply even if you may not meet every requirement in this posting. We value diversity and our environment is supportive, challenging and focused on the consistent delivery of high quality, meaningful work.

In return, we’ll give you a competitive salary, flexible working arrangements and a lot of personal development opportunities. We operate a hybrid working model with at least 1 - 2 days in our offices in Oxford.

When you apply for a job with us, we process some of your personal information. You can find out more about how we process your information on our company website: https://habitat.energy/privacy-policy/ .

title: Software Engineer
description:
Software Engineer

Habitat Energy is a fast growing technology company focussed on the physical and financial optimisation of energy storage and renewable generation assets globally through complex models and trading. By maximising the returns from these assets we aim to drive investment in renewable energy and accelerate the transition to a low carbon world. Our rapidly growing team of 130+ people in Austin, TX, Oxford, UK, and Melbourne, Australia brings together exceptionally talented and passionate people in the domains of energy trading, data science, software engineering and renewable energy management.

We have a vacancy for a Software Engineer to join our UK Software team based in Oxford. In this role, you will be part of the team responsible for building, maintaining and evolving our renewable energy platform. This platform enables our trading and operations teams to manage and optimise one of the largest fleet of battery energy storage sites in the UK. You will be joining a number of talented, multi-disciplined software engineers who want to build resilient, scalable software to help enable the net-zero transition.

Your responsibilities will include:
Developing and maintaining our applications

- Maintain existing code and own brand new applications. We have written and deployed dozens of different microservice APIs and UIs covering asset dispatch and monitoring, trade management and exposure, reporting and settlements, market interfaces for manual and automated trading, data consumers required for forecasting and optimization. Operations and markets keep changing and so do we.

Collaborating with internal teams to understand challenges and work towards defining solutions

- Interface with traders, data scientists, ops analysts and other software engineers to understand the needs and requirements from our software. Navigate the different market and third party tooling to help architect robust and scalable solutions.

Ensuring that software is designed, built, released and maintained in accordance with our SDLC process

- Write clean and tested code. Check deployments on our Kubernetes cluster are successful and work as expected. Write clear documentation, including troubleshooting runbooks, to enable on-call support. Participate positively in peer reviews for and from colleagues to ensure the quality of all our software applications.

Participating in rotating on-call support of operations

- All software engineers are expected to take an equal share of the tech-on-call rota. This forms the first point of call for software support issues. Utilising runbooks, support Trading and Operations in live troubleshooting, using the escalation procedure as required.

Requirements
Preferred skills and experience:

- 3+ years of Python experience

- Proficiency with API frameworks (FastAPI, Django, etc.)

- Experience with modelling databases with Python (ideally SQLAlchemy)

- Experience developing UIs with moderns frameworks (e.g. Vue)

- Desire to be part of a fast-paced team, working with live, operational assets

- Writing code that is clean and tested

- Positive, open, and honest approach to technical and interpersonal challenges

- Can communicate complex issues and solutions to technical and non-technical stakeholders

‘Nice to have’ skills and experience:

- Experience in energy/power trading

- Experience with Vue

- Experience with AWS

- Experience with Docker

- Experience with Github Actions

- Experience with Kubernetes

- Experience with real-time (streaming) data management, transformation and orchestration tools and approaches

- Experience working with microservice architectures, with a focus on zero-downtime deployments and scalability
